# First, find the winner's country
winner_row = df[df['Rank'] == 1]
winner_country = winner_row['Cyclist'].iloc[0].split('(')[-1].strip(')')

# Filter top 10 rows (Rank <= 10)
top_10 = df[df['Rank'] <= 10]

# Extract country from each cyclist in top 10
top_10['Country'] = top_10['Cyclist'].str.extract(r'\(([^)]+)\)')

# Filter rows where country matches winner's country, excluding the winner itself
same_country_cyclists = top_10[(top_10['Country'] == winner_country) & (top_10['Rank'] != 1)]

# Sort by Rank (ascending) to get the ranking order
same_country_cyclists = same_country_cyclists.sort_values('Rank')

# Get the cyclist names (preserving exact text) as a comma-separated string
answer = ', '.join(same_country_cyclists['Cyclist'].tolist())
